note_on_ambiguity: Starting in 2022, the IC3 renamed the combined 'BEC/EAC' category to simply 'Business Email Compromise' (BEC). However, this broad category still functionally encompasses both organizational and personal email compromises. The report cites 21,832 complaints and over $2.7 billion in adjusted losses. It is still not possible to isolate the figures corresponding exclusively to Organizational Spear Phishing.
